text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since arriving
at this mysterious place with Gold Ship—
(*Whoooosh...*)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah... Back to life...
The hydration's soakin' right into my soul...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Kinda makes ya think... maybe dried wakame seaweed
feels like this every time it gets soaked in water...

Sipping the coconut water from the fruit Gold Ship had cracked bare-handed,
the two of us, for some reason, shared a peaceful moment together.
The sound of crashing waves and the sweet coconut juice felt soothing to my tired body...

As time passed,
I strangely began to feel that staying like this wouldn't be so bad...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh... Look at you, finally gettin' a decent look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Pretty nice, ain't it? Kickin' back and takin' it easy once in a while...
choice_data_list: Do you often spend your time like this?
Do you often spend your time like this?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, pretty much.
They always say even warriors need a place to rest, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
By the way, 'warriors' is a figure of speech for Umamusume who race—
or a 'metaphor,' if you wanna get all chuunibyou about it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: How should I put it... races are seriously passionate places.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Even the quietest folks
let their raw instincts loose when they're on the track.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
With everyone baring their fighting spirit, when I take off my own limiter,
everything inside me heats up and it feels crazy refreshing.
choice_data_list: You really love racing, don't you?
You really love racing, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If someone asked me whether I liked it more than Eastern Japanese common toads,
I'd say 'racing' without hesitation...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Still though... it's seriously relaxing out here...
(Crash...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The ebb and flow of crashing waves... ya feel me?
Talk about total wabi-sabi...
(Crash...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... so healing...
Honestly, I could totally live here forever...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Pheeewwww.........

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhhh............

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
GYAAAAAAAHHHHHHH
HHHHHHH—?!?!?!?
choice_data_list: What happened all of a sudden?!
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
CRAPPPPPPPPPP!!
My frustration levels are through the roof!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
By deliberately getting away from pre-race tension
and soaking in utter bliss, you ignite a fiery thirst for victory!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And that raw impulse takes the wheel!!
Fire!! Burning!! EXPLOSIONNN!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
This is it! THIS is the exact 'hungry spirit'
I've been looking for all along!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, on your feet, Trainer!!
We're heading back right this second!! Right now!!
choice_data_list: I don't understand any of this...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm saying our work here is done,
so we're going home!
choice_data_list: What did we even come here for in the end?!
What did we even come here for in the end?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, slow on the uptake, aren't ya?!
What are you, an alien made of mushroom broth?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Bottling up frustration before a showdown
is how I get properly fired up!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And now, I'm itching to run so bad I can hardly stand it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Besides, my race is tomorrow anyway!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm... huh? Didn't I mention that?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My bad, my bad! ☆
Turns out tomorrow's my debut race.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My dazzling run's gonna move you—and all of America—to tears!
Ooooooohhh, I'm so hyped I could burst!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And with that, we're outta here!!
Alright, pack up the coconuts!! Make sure they go back into the soil!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The way back is... well, beats me, but probably that way!
C'mon, move it, follow meeee!!

And just like that, the treasure hunt that began out of nowhere came to an abrupt end...
(To be continued)
